S.I. Special Branch
May 18,
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 1207
Date 4 / 12 / 40
Miss Vivian Christine DORF
D.S. Lockwood

Miss Vivian Christine Dorf, born 1916 in
Viatke, Russia, is of Danish Nationality. Her
father, prior to his death in 1919, was a prosperous
Danish merchant and acting Danish-Consul in that city;
her mother is Russian. Following the outbreak of
the Russian revolution, Mrs. Dorf accompanied by her
daughter arrived in Shanghai from Siberia. While a
resident of this city she made many attempts to
establish a business. All her ventures failed, however,
and as her means were limited she appealed to the
Danish Association for assistance which was forthcoming
in the form of a monthly allowance. In view of the
patriotic career of Miss Dorf's father, a prominent
member of the Danish community - Mr. K. Rothe of the
Shanghai Telephone Company - interested himself in
the family and assumed responsibility for Miss Dorf's
education, which she received from a private teacher.
At the age of 16 Miss Dorf discontinued her
studies and obtained a position as stenographer in
the Christien Literature Society, 128 Museum Road.
She remained in this situation for some two years,
when she resigned to marry a Mr. Edwin Olaf Stratton-
Christensen, British, on October 13, 1935 at the
Union Church, Shanghai. Her matrimonial venture
was not successful, as a few months later the
couple separated to be followed by Mrs. Christensen

薇薇安·克里斯汀·多尔夫小姐（Miss Vivian Christine DORF）
D.S. 洛克伍德（Lockwood）

薇薇安·克里斯汀·多尔夫小姐，1916年生于俄罗斯维亚特卡（Viatke），系丹麦国籍。其父于1919年去世前，是该市一位富有的丹麦商人及代理丹麦领事；其母为俄罗斯人。俄国革命爆发后，多尔夫夫人携女儿从西伯利亚抵达上海。居住本市期间，她多次尝试经商。然而所有尝试均告失败，鉴于其资力有限，她向丹麦协会求助，该协会以每月津贴的形式提供了援助。鉴于多尔夫小姐之父的爱国事迹，丹麦侨民中的知名人士——上海电话公司的K. Rothe先生——对该家庭予以关照，并承担起了多尔夫小姐的教育责任，她由此接受私人教师的教导。
16岁时，多尔夫小姐中断学业，在博物馆路128号基督文学社（Christien Literature Society）获得一份速记员职位。她在此任职约两年，后于1935年10月13日在上海联合教堂（Union Church）辞职，与英国人埃德温·奥拉夫·斯特拉顿-克里斯滕森先生（Mr. Edwin Olaf Stratton-Christensen）结婚。她的婚姻生活并不成功，数月后夫妇分居，随后克里斯滕森夫人

pages.en:
( 2 )

resuming the use of her maiden name.
For the first seven months of 1936 Miss Dorf
did not hold any permanent positions, but in the
Autumn, on the strong recommendation of the Danish
Consul in Shanghai, Professor J.S. Henderssen,
Director of the Museum of Far Eastern Antiques,
Stockholm appointed her as secretary to the Scientific
Mission of which he was the leader. Miss Dorf was
particulary suited to his vocation as she was a
brilliant linguist, being able to speak four European
languages and several Chinese dialects. Her flair
for this calling was shown when she delivered a lecture
at the Royal Asiatic Society (November 7, 1937), on her
experiences in Sinkiang Province. Miss Dorf accompanied
the Mission on its expedition to Indo-China, when it left
Shanghai for the French possession on board the s.s. "Taiyuan"
on December 18, 1937. She is in possession of British
Passport No. C.26006 dated December 18, 1937 issued by the
British Consulate-General, Shanghai.
Enquiries show that prior to the departure of the
Scientific Mission to Europe, Professor Henderssen offered
Miss Dorf a permanent position on the staff of the museum, which
offer she rejected as the renumeration was not sufficient.
It is believed, however, by her friends in Shanghai, that
she obtained employment in Baie D'Aloney, and her address
is given as follows:-
c/o P. Lapique,
Vulchay,
Baie D'Alony,
Indo-China.
pages.zh:
( 2 )

恢复使用其婚前姓氏。
1936年的前七个月，多尔夫小姐未担任任何固定职务，但在秋季，经上海丹麦领事强烈推荐，斯德哥尔摩远东古物博物馆馆长J.S. Henderssen教授任命她为其领导的科学考察团的秘书。多尔夫小姐特别适合此职，因为她是一位杰出的语言学家，能说四种欧洲语言和几种中国方言。她在这一领域的天赋体现在她于皇家亚洲文会（1937年11月7日）就其在新疆省的经历发表演讲时。1937年12月18日，考察团乘“太原”轮（s.s. "Taiyuan"）离开上海前往法属印度支那，多尔夫小姐随团同行。她持有英国护照，号码C.26006，由英国驻上海总领事馆于1937年12月18日签发。
调查显示，在科学考察团启程前往欧洲之前，Henderssen教授曾向多尔夫小姐提供博物馆的固定职员职位，但因薪酬不足，她拒绝了该提议。然而，她在上海的朋友认为，她已在安南湾（Baie D'Aloney）就业，其地址如下：
转交 P. Lapique，
Vulchay，
安南湾（Baie D'Alony），
印度支那。

pages.en:
( 3 )

It is learned that Miss Dorf has no intention to
return to Shanghai, and she has requested Mr. Rothe
to forward all her personal luggage to Hong Kong.
Miss Dorf is held in great respect by the
local Danish community, not only on account of
her educational attainments and character, but,
for the gratitude she has shown the Danish
Association for supporting her family during the
first few years in Shanghai. In addition, she
has refunded to the Association, monies contributed
by them to the upkeep of the family.

D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).
pages.zh:
( 3 )

据悉，多尔夫小姐无意返回上海，并已请求Rothe先生将其所有个人行李寄往香港。
多尔夫小姐深受本地丹麦侨民界的敬重，这不仅因为她的学识和品行，还因为她对丹麦协会在其初到上海的头几年资助其家庭所表示的感激之情。此外，她还向该协会偿还了由其提供的用于维持家庭生计的款项。

D. S.

D.C.（特别科）。
